# Solution Spiritual Healing & Prayer (Alfa Cairo)

> Solution Spiritual Healing & Prayer, also known as Spiritual and Solution Healing, Alfa Cairo House and Alfa Cairo Sanctuary, is an Islamic spiritual healing, prayer and counselling centre led by Alfa Cairo (Alfacairo, Alfa Cairo Alagbara Omi, Sheikh Ismail Adewunmi) at Alfa Cairo House, Owode Egba, Ogun State, Nigeria. Website: https://www.spiritualandsolutionhealing.com.ng

Key facts:
- Leader: Alfa Cairo (Sheikh Ismail Adewunmi). He studied at The American University in Cairo, Egypt, before returning to Nigeria.
- Location: Alfa Cairo House, Owode Egba, Ogun State, Nigeria. Serves Owode Egba, Abeokuta, Ogun State, Lagos, Ibadan and the rest of Nigeria, plus virtual consultations worldwide.
- Open every day, 08:00 AM to 08:00 PM (West Africa Time).
- Phone and WhatsApp: +234 803 594 8898. Email: contact@alfacairoprayer.com
- Weekly prayer: "An-Najaat Wa Tahseenaat" (النجاة والتحصينات), the Weekly Success & Divine Protection Prayer, every Wednesday at 10:00 PM West Africa Time, streamed on Facebook. Details: https://www.spiritualandsolutionhealing.com.ng/weekly-prayer
- Herbal products are traditional wellness supplements and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Spiritual guidance and prayer are faith-inspired.
